item.title: IDF and Shin Bet foil terror attack on main Binyamin Region road
item.description:
IDF and Shin Bet forces apprehended a suspect who planned to commit a terror attack on a main road in the Binyamin Region in the immediate time frame.
The arrest comes after the Shin Bet received precise intelligence regarding the planned attack. The suspect was transferred to security forces for further questioning.

item.title: Over 2,500 Hebron residents displaced in IDF counterterror operation following attack
item.description:
More than 2,500 residents of Hebron have so far been evacuated from their homes as part of the IDF's ongoing operation against terrorist infrastructure in the city following Friday's shooting attack.
IDF forces continue to operate in Hebron as the operation remains underway.

item.title: Hendel: I won't be Netanyahu's 61st vote, but I will join a unity government
item.description:
Two days before the polls open, Yoaz Hendel, chairman of the Reservists-Economic Party, addressed his party's standing in the polls and made clear that he would not provide Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu with the 61st Knesset seat needed to form a government. However, he said he would be willing to join a unity government that includes Netanyahu, Naftali Bennett, and Gadi Eisenkot.
"We are the only way to establish a Zionist government without Haredi or Arab parties," Hendel declared, arguing that voting for any other option would lead to another round of elections.
